summary.cost_note: Rate-card estimate, not confirmed billing. Shared initial calls are charged once physically, attributed once to each policy path; never sum policy allocations as billing.
summary.latency_note: Policy end-to-end paths include initial and own review with Governor I/O; exclude competing arms' queue time. Paired execution wall time is recorded per task. These are shared-artifact paths, not independently timed policy deployments.
summary.uncertainty_note: Wilson intervals are descriptive; paired intervals resample task families because templated tasks are correlated. Tiny pilots provide weak uncertainty estimates.
summary.selection_error_note: Observed Always-arm rescue/regression is a paired proxy, not a stochastic counterfactual guarantee for Selective.

audit.limitation: Lexical and family disjointness do not prove semantic independence; tasks within a family are correlated.
